title: Database Save Event Type - Data API
description: Database Save events track when records are created, updated, or deleted. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

FIRST_ENTITY_ID.description: The first ID that is logged when an update occurs. If a single record is updated, the ID of that row is logged. If multiple records are updated, only one ID is logged.

KEY_PREFIX.description: The key prefix of the entity type that was saved.

LOGIN_KEY.description: The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login session.

NUM_ROWS.description: The number of entities that were saved.

REQUEST_ID.description: Globally unique id for a given request.

SAMPLE_FACTOR.description: The ratio of saved entities that were logged. A value of 1 means every entity saved was logged. A value of 100 means that 1 out of 100 entities saved was logged.

SESSION_KEY.description: The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify all user events within a session. When a user logs out and logs in again, a new session is started.

TIMESTAMP.description: The Timestamp at which the log event was generated.

TIMESTAMP_DERIVED.description: The access time of Salesforce services in ISO8601-compatible format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ).

USER_ID.description: The ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API.
